how_to_apply: Sign Up: Register on the HPRCA portal (hprca.hp.gov.in) by creating a username and password
One-Time Registration (OTR): Complete OTR by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), a recent photograph and signature, and relevant supporting documents
Complete/Update Profile: Ensure the profile is complete before applying; existing users can edit details such as qualification or contact information
Apply for the Post: View the list of available posts on the HPRCA portal and click "Apply" against the Clerk post
Select Preferred Exam District: Choose preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu (subject to availability of centre/nodes)
Confirm Application Details: Review the auto-filled application form before proceeding
Pay Application Fee: Pay ₹800/- through the available online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking)
Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, the application is considered complete

The downloaded/printed copy of the online application, along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies, must be produced at the time of document verification. No offline application form is accepted.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: HPRCA has advertised a total of 40 Clerk posts under Post Code 26045 in the Department of Personnel (Secretariat Administration Services-I). The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease as per HPRCA's general instructions.

rows.no_of_posts: 40 (Gen(UR)-17, EWS-04, OBC(UR)-07, OBC(BPL)-01, SC(UR)-09, SC(BPL)-01, ST(UR)-01)

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification, typing speed, and domicile-linked schooling conditions given below. Eligibility is assessed as on 11.09.2026, the closing date for submission of the ORA. In addition, the notification states that a candidate shall be eligible for appointment only if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from a school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition does not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.

rows.details: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
Minimum 30 words per minute in English type writing, or 25 words per minute in Hindi type writing, on computer
Knowledge of customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh, and suitability for appointment in the peculiar conditions prevailing in the Pradesh

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 45 years Age will be reckoned as on 01.01.2026 Upper age relaxation of up to 5 years is permissible for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Classes who are domiciles of Himachal Pradesh, Persons with Disabilities, employees of the Himachal Pradesh Government, and Ex-servicemen of Himachal Pradesh, as per the general or special order(s) of the Department of Personnel, Government of Himachal Pradesh Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Application Fee
content_sections.text: All categories of candidates are required to pay the same fee for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026, payable only through the online payment gateway. Payment can be made using Credit Card, Debit Card or Net Banking. No other mode of payment is accepted, and the fee once paid is neither refunded nor held in reserve for any other examination.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged as a Job Trainee under the Job Trainee Scheme-2025 (notified by the Department of Personnel vide notification No. PER(AP)-C-B(15)-3/2024 dated 19.07.2025, and a subsequent letter dated 26.09.2025) and will receive a consolidated fixed amount of ₹12,500/- per month. A detailed regular pay scale/pay band structure beyond this consolidated Job Trainee amount is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.text: Note: The notification is not fully consistent on when the correction window begins — one clause states it commences "after the closing date," while another states it commences "after three days from the closing date." Candidates should confirm the exact correction-window dates on the HPRCA website once activated.

content_sections.heading: HPRCA Clerk Selection Process
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT)/written screening test of 120 marks, of 1½ hours (one and a half hours) duration, or as decided by the Aayog The test consists of 120 multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark, covering: General Knowledge (including HP General Knowledge and Current Affairs); Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English and General Hindi of Matric Standard; and Word Processing on computer Minimum qualifying marks: 45% for General category, 40% for SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters — relaxable by up to 5% (to 40% for General and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF) if sufficient candidates are not available Shortlisted candidates (based on CBT/screening test merit) must then appear for a prescribed typing skill test, which is qualifying in nature In multi-shift CBT exams, scores are normalized using the Z-Score (Mean and Standard Deviation) Method Final selection is followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates

content_sections.text: Sign Up: Register on the HPRCA portal (hprca.hp.gov.in) by creating a username and password One-Time Registration (OTR): Complete OTR by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), a recent photograph and signature, and relevant supporting documents Complete/Update Profile: Ensure the profile is complete before applying; existing users can edit details such as qualification or contact information Apply for the Post: View the list of available posts on the HPRCA portal and click "Apply" against the Clerk post Select Preferred Exam District: Choose preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu (subject to availability of centre/nodes) Confirm Application Details: Review the auto-filled application form before proceeding Pay Application Fee: Pay ₹800/- through the available online payment gateway (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking) Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, the application is considered complete The downloaded/printed copy of the online application, along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies, must be produced at the time of document verification. No offline application form is accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog, Hamirpur, under Advertisement No. 13/2026, to fill 40 Clerk (Job Trainee) posts in the Department of Personnel (Secretariat Administration Services-I).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 40 vacancies are available for the post of Clerk (Job Trainee), post code 26045.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application (ORA) can be submitted till 11.09.2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University, along with a minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi on computer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 45 years, reckoned as on 01.01.2026, with age relaxation of up to 5 years for eligible reserved categories, PwD candidates, HP government employees and ex-servicemen of HP.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All categories of candidates must pay ₹800/- in total (₹100 examination fee + ₹700 processing fee), payable online only.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through hprca.hp.gov.in by completing Sign Up, One-Time Registration, profile completion, and then applying for the Clerk post, followed by online fee payment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 120-mark Computer Based Test/written screening test followed by a qualifying typing skill test and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for HPRCA Clerk (Job Trainee)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will get a consolidated fixed amount of ₹12,500/- per month as a Job Trainee under the Job Trainee Scheme-2025.

faq.question: Q10. Is domicile of Himachal Pradesh required for HPRCA Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from a school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh, unless they are Bonafide Himachalis. Reservation benefits are also available only to bona fide residents of Himachal Pradesh; reserved-category candidates from other states are treated as General (UR) category.
